noData: No usage data. Check Codex CLI and your ChatGPT sign-in.
promptHint: May use quota. Does not spend reset credits.
creditHint: Requires confirmation and spends a real credit.
pendingReset: Unconfirmed attempt: a retry will reuse the saved key.
automationHint: A minimal prompt, never an automatic credit reset.
backgroundHint: Usage updates every 5 min. Closing this panel frees its webview.
executeBody: This sends “Responde solo: OK” to Codex and may use quota. With the cycle enabled, the next attempt will be in 5 hours.
resetBody: Spend one real credit to reset eligible Codex limits? This cannot be undone.
retryBody: The persisted idempotency key will be reused. This does not create a new credit-consumption attempt.
automationBody: If no recent attempt is recorded, a prompt will be sent now, then every 5 hours. Reset credits are never spent automatically.
preview: Interface preview · real actions require the Tauri app.
log.started: Codex Usage started. Usage reads do not spend reset credits.
log.promptStart: Starting minimal prompt with {model} (120 s maximum).
log.resetStart: Reset confirmed by user. Idempotency key persisted.
log.alreadyRedeemed: This reset was already applied; no extra credit was spent.
log.nothingToReset: No limit is eligible for a reset.
error.absolutePath: Enter the absolute path of an existing Codex executable.
error.exe: On Windows, select codex.exe, not a .cmd or .bat script.
error.noWindows: The account returned no usage windows.
error.noAccount: Codex did not identify the account. No credit will be spent.
error.accountChanged: The account changed. Review the data and confirm again.
error.pendingAccount: A reset is pending for another account. No request will be sent.
error.noCredits: No credits available, or availability is unknown.
error.uncertain: Reset not confirmed: {detail}. The same key is preserved for a retry.
error.unknownReset: Unknown reset response. The key is preserved; there will be no automatic retry.
error.autostartDev: Launch at sign-in is only available in release builds.
error.timeout: Codex did not respond within 25 seconds.
error.closed: Codex closed without a response, or exceeded the 1 MiB output limit.
error.outputLimit: Codex output exceeded the size limit.
error.noResponse: Codex finished without an assistant response.
error.start: Could not start Codex CLI. Check the executable and ChatGPT sign-in: {detail}
error.corruptState: Invalid state.json; it will not be overwritten: {detail}
error.connect: Could not connect to the app: {detail}
